# Mara Voss
*Capturing the quiet dialogue between light and earth.*

![Hero Image](images/hero-mountain.jpg)

## The Philosophy
**Context:** *The core approach*
Mara Voss focuses on the "in-between" moments of the natural world. Her work seeks to capture the transition between seasons, where the atmosphere is as much a subject as the terrain itself.

## The Dolomites: A Study in Texture
**Split:** *Two-column layout*

| The Rugged Peaks | The Soft Light |
| :--- | :--- |
| The jagged limestone of the Dolomites provides a structural backbone for her compositions. Each peak tells a story of millions of years of erosion and tectonic shift. | She prefers the "blue hour," where the harsh edges of the mountains are softened by a cool, ethereal glow. This creates a sense of depth and serenity. |
